chapters.title: How a request is served
chapters.text: Every request passes the same three steps. The router picks a handler by the path, auth checks the session cookie, and the handler builds the reply from the database. A request that fails auth never reaches a handler.

steps.label: route
steps.does: picks a handler by the path

steps.label: handle
steps.does: builds the reply from the database

chapters.title: Where the code is
chapters.text: Most of the code is the handlers. Auth is small, but every request passes it.
